requirements.title: Lắp ghép sản phẩm
requirements.text: When a valid product manifest is loaded, the system shall expose only its enabled plugin contributions.

acs.title: Lắp ghép sản phẩm
acs.given: product A bật document-review; marketing không được cài
acs.then: route document-review tồn tại; route marketing trả 404; không tạo bảng marketing

requirements.title: Không rò nghiệp vụ vào kernel
requirements.text: The framework shall support a second business domain without modifications to kernel source.

acs.title: Không rò nghiệp vụ vào kernel
acs.given: kernel digest K và hai fixture document-review, marketing
acs.when: build hai sản phẩm dùng K
acs.then: kernel digest giống nhau; cả hai fixture hoàn thành workflow được khai báo

requirements.title: Không bắt buộc AI
requirements.text: Where no model plugin is installed, the system shall execute deterministic workflows without provider credentials.

acs.title: Không bắt buộc AI
acs.given: fixture checksum chỉ có input artifact và deterministic handler
acs.then: output hash đúng fixture; provider calls=0; không yêu cầu model key

requirements.title: Cấu hình không hợp lệ
requirements.text: If product configuration contains an unknown capability, the system shall reject activation before serving product routes.

acs.title: Cấu hình không hợp lệ
acs.given: manifest khai báo capability không có trong registry
acs.then: CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED; readiness=false; tenant routes chưa được phục vụ

requirements.title: Bản đóng gói tái sử dụng
requirements.text: When a product consumes a released framework package, the system shall resolve its declared contract compatibility without copying framework source.

acs.title: Bản đóng gói tái sử dụng
acs.given: sample app bên ngoài monorepo dùng package phát hành
acs.then: không có source fork; compatible contract hoạt động; digest package có trong lockfile

requirements.title: Manifest có phiên bản
requirements.text: When a plugin manifest is submitted, the system shall validate it against the declared manifest schema.

acs.title: Manifest có phiên bản
acs.given: manifest fixture hợp lệ và schema 1.0.0
acs.then: kết quả VALID gắn schema version và artifact digest

requirements.title: Chu trình dependency
requirements.text: If plugin dependencies contain a cycle, the system shall reject the installation plan before executing migrations.

acs.title: Chu trình dependency
acs.given: plugin A cần B và B cần A
acs.then: DEPENDENCY_CYCLE kèm đường chu trình; migrations=0; installed registry không đổi

requirements.title: Dependency thiếu
requirements.text: If a required dependency cannot be resolved, the system shall reject the installation plan.

acs.title: Dependency thiếu
acs.given: plugin A yêu cầu contract x@2; chỉ có x@1
acs.then: DEPENDENCY_UNSATISFIED; không tải runtime code

requirements.title: Artifact bị tráo
requirements.text: If an artifact digest differs from its signed manifest, the system shall quarantine that artifact before execution.

acs.title: Artifact bị tráo
acs.given: artifact bytes đã sửa sau ký
acs.then: ARTIFACT_INTEGRITY; handler calls=0; artifact QUARANTINED

requirements.title: Lockfile tái lập
requirements.text: When dependencies resolve successfully, the system shall emit a lockfile containing immutable artifact digests.

acs.title: Lockfile tái lập
acs.given: registry có hai phiên bản tương thích
acs.when: resolve rồi resolve với lockfile đã sinh
acs.then: lần hai chọn cùng digests; không tự lấy bản mới

requirements.title: Phạm vi extension point
requirements.text: If a plugin accesses an undeclared extension point, the system shall deny registration before startup completion.

acs.title: Phạm vi extension point
acs.given: module A truy cập điểm riêng của B
acs.then: EXTENSION_SCOPE_DENIED; B không bị thay handler

requirements.title: Cài nhưng chưa chạy
requirements.text: When a verified installation plan completes, the system shall place the plugin in INSTALLED_DISABLED state.

acs.title: Cài nhưng chưa chạy
acs.given: manifest đã verify; migration additive thành công
acs.then: state INSTALLED_DISABLED; handler chưa nhận việc

requirements.title: Quyền khi bật plugin
requirements.text: When an administrator enables a plugin, the system shall restrict execution to explicitly granted capabilities.

acs.title: Quyền khi bật plugin
acs.given: plugin xin read và publish; admin chỉ cấp read
acs.then: read hoạt động; publish CAPABILITY_DENIED; provider mutation=0

requirements.title: Pin phiên bản run
requirements.text: When a run starts, the system shall pin its plugin artifact and workflow contract versions.

acs.title: Pin phiên bản run
acs.given: v1 đang active; tạo run R; sau đó cài v2
acs.then: R dùng digest v1; run mới dùng v2 theo rollout policy

requirements.title: Drain trước disable
requirements.text: When normal disable is requested, the system shall stop accepting new work for that plugin version.

acs.title: Drain trước disable
acs.given: v1 có một run đang chạy
acs.then: new run bị PLUGIN_DRAINING; run cũ tiếp tục theo cancellation policy

requirements.title: Thu hồi khẩn cấp
requirements.text: If a plugin version is security-revoked, the system shall prevent its next host-mediated action.

acs.title: Thu hồi khẩn cấp
acs.given: run v1 đã pin nhưng signer hoặc digest bị revoke
acs.then: PLUGIN_REVOKED; external calls=0 sau điểm enforcement; run chuyển BLOCKED

requirements.title: Giữ dữ liệu khi uninstall
requirements.text: When a plugin is uninstalled, the system shall retain its referenced audit and evidence records under retention policy.

acs.title: Giữ dữ liệu khi uninstall
acs.given: run hoàn tất còn liên kết evidence thuộc plugin
acs.then: UI plugin biến mất; audit và evidence vẫn truy xuất bởi auditor được phép

requirements.title: Migration không rollback được
requirements.text: If an upgrade crosses a declared irreversible migration boundary, the system shall reject automatic code rollback.

acs.title: Migration không rollback được
acs.given: migration ghi dữ liệu không tương thích v1
acs.then: ROLLBACK_UNSAFE; không deploy v1; cung cấp forward-repair runbook

requirements.title: Không tự nâng trust
requirements.text: If a tenant-installed plugin requests native execution, the system shall reject it before loading executable code.

acs.title: Không tự nâng trust
acs.given: tenant uploader gửi native artifact
acs.then: TRUST_CLASS_DENIED; process library chưa nạp

requirements.title: Capability handles
requirements.text: The sandbox shall expose only host resources granted to the plugin invocation.

acs.title: Capability handles
acs.given: Wasm plugin chỉ có artifact.read cho artifact A
acs.then: RESOURCE_DENIED; nội dung B không có trong result hay logs

requirements.title: Ngắt vòng lặp vô hạn
requirements.text: If an invocation exhausts its execution budget, the system shall terminate that invocation without terminating the host.

acs.title: Ngắt vòng lặp vô hạn
acs.given: Wasm fixture vòng lặp vô hạn; profile L-WASM
acs.then: SANDBOX_LIMIT; host health vẫn OK; invocation kết thúc trong deadline profile

requirements.title: Host I/O bị treo
requirements.text: If a host-mediated I/O deadline expires, the system shall cancel that operation independently of guest instruction metering.

acs.title: Host I/O bị treo
acs.given: mock host HTTP không trả body
acs.then: HOST_IO_TIMEOUT trong giới hạn; không giữ worker lease vô hạn

requirements.title: Egress chống SSRF
requirements.text: If an outbound target resolves to a forbidden address, the system shall reject connection establishment.

acs.title: Egress chống SSRF — case 1
acs.given: URL đổi DNS sang loopback hoặc metadata address
acs.then: EGRESS_DENIED; TCP tới địa chỉ cấm=0

acs.title: Egress chống SSRF — case 2
acs.given: redirect HTTPS từ public sang private subnet
acs.then: EGRESS_DENIED; credentials không chuyển sang origin khác

requirements.title: RPC có fence
requirements.text: If a remote result carries an expired execution fence, the system shall reject the result before business-state mutation.

acs.title: RPC có fence
acs.given: worker W1 lease=1 hết hạn; W2 có lease=2
acs.then: STALE_FENCE; output W2 không bị ghi đè

requirements.title: Dọn sandbox
requirements.text: When an invocation ends, the system shall release its scoped handles and temporary storage.

acs.title: Dọn sandbox
acs.given: invocation tạo temp artifact và handle H
acs.then: H không dùng lại được; temp không còn sau cleanup deadline; retained artifact không bị xóa

requirements.title: Login bằng redirect
requirements.text: When a browser starts login, the system shall create a one-time authorization transaction bound to that browser.

acs.title: Login bằng redirect
acs.given: browser chưa có session
acs.then: redirect tới issuer đã allowlist; state, nonce, PKCE transaction dùng một lần

requirements.title: Callback hợp lệ
requirements.text: When a valid authorization callback is received, the system shall establish a server-side session for the verified subject.

acs.title: Callback hợp lệ
acs.given: mock issuer trả token đúng issuer, audience, nonce; code chưa dùng
acs.then: session mới gắn issuer+sub; cookie HttpOnly Secure; tokens không xuất hiện trong response body

requirements.title: Callback giả hoặc replay
requirements.text: If callback verification fails, the system shall reject session creation.

acs.title: Callback giả hoặc replay
acs.given: state mismatch, nonce mismatch, issuer mismatch hoặc code replay
acs.then: 401 AUTH_INVALID_CALLBACK; session count không tăng; không lộ token

requirements.title: Redirect đích không tin cậy
requirements.text: If a login return target is outside the product allowlist, the system shall reject the target before redirecting.

acs.title: Redirect đích không tin cậy
acs.given: return_to=https://attacker.example hoặc //attacker.example
acs.then: 400 RETURN_TARGET_DENIED; không redirect ra origin lạ

requirements.title: Không dùng password grant
requirements.text: If a caller submits password-grant credentials to the application, the system shall reject the request without forwarding credentials.

acs.title: Không dùng password grant
acs.given: request username/password tới BFF
acs.then: AUTH_FLOW_UNSUPPORTED; Keycloak grant calls=0; mật khẩu không ghi log

requirements.title: Discovery trust
requirements.text: If issuer metadata violates the configured issuer trust policy, the system shall reject identity-provider activation.

acs.title: Discovery trust
acs.given: discovery có issuer khác hoặc endpoint private ngoài allowlist
acs.then: ISSUER_TRUST_FAILED; không tải JWKS qua endpoint lạ

requirements.title: Không ghép account bằng email
requirements.text: If two verified identities share an email but differ in issuer or subject, the system shall keep them distinct unless an authenticated linking flow completes.

acs.title: Không ghép account bằng email
acs.given: IdP A/sub1 và B/sub2 cùng email
acs.then: hai identity records; membership không chuyển qua email match

requirements.title: Recovery qua identity provider
requirements.text: When a user requests account recovery or MFA enrollment, the system shall delegate credential management to the configured identity provider.

acs.title: Recovery qua identity provider
acs.given: user ở login/account settings
acs.then: đến verified IdP flow; app không thu password reset token hoặc tự đổi credential database

requirements.title: Chống session fixation
requirements.text: When authentication privilege increases, the system shall rotate the application session identifier.

acs.title: Chống session fixation
acs.given: session guest có ID S
acs.then: ID mới khác S; S không dùng được để gọi API

requirements.title: CSRF cho cookie API
requirements.text: If a cookie-authenticated mutation lacks a valid origin and CSRF proof, the system shall reject it before mutation.

acs.title: CSRF cho cookie API
acs.given: attacker origin hoặc token thiếu
acs.then: 403 CSRF_REJECTED; state version không đổi

requirements.title: Expiry phiên
requirements.text: If a session exceeds its configured idle or absolute expiry, the system shall deny authenticated access.

acs.title: Expiry phiên
acs.given: virtual clock đúng expiry hoặc vượt expiry
acs.then: 401 SESSION_EXPIRED; không gia hạn phiên đã hết hạn

requirements.title: Logout ứng dụng
requirements.text: When a user logs out, the system shall invalidate the corresponding application session.

acs.title: Logout ứng dụng
acs.given: session S đang active
acs.then: S bị revoke; API dùng S trả 401

requirements.title: Backchannel logout
requirements.text: When a verified backchannel logout event arrives, the system shall revoke matching application sessions.

acs.title: Backchannel logout — case 1
acs.given: logout token có sid hợp lệ đúng issuer/audience
acs.then: các phiên matching bị revoke; unrelated sessions còn active

acs.title: Backchannel logout — case 2
acs.given: logout token sai chữ ký hoặc replay jti
acs.then: sai chữ ký bị từ chối; replay idempotent; không revoke unrelated subject

requirements.title: Invitation một lần
requirements.text: When an eligible invitee accepts a valid invitation, the system shall create the invited tenant membership once.

acs.title: Invitation một lần
acs.given: invite đúng tenant/email đã verify; chưa hết hạn
acs.then: một membership; response replay trả cùng membership; không thêm role khác

requirements.title: Owner cuối cùng
requirements.text: If membership removal would leave a tenant without an owner, the system shall reject the removal.

acs.title: Owner cuối cùng
acs.given: tenant có đúng một owner
acs.then: 409 LAST_OWNER; membership không đổi

requirements.title: Thu hồi phiên trên giao diện
requirements.text: When current membership is revoked, the system shall invalidate tenant-scoped browser data access.

acs.title: Thu hồi phiên trên giao diện
acs.given: browser đang mở tenant A với SSE và cache
acs.then: SSE tenant A đóng theo L-REVOKE; cache A bị xóa; deep link trả 404

requirements.title: Deny mặc định
requirements.text: The system shall deny resource actions without an applicable authorization permit.

acs.title: Deny mặc định
acs.given: user có membership nhưng action chưa được grant
acs.then: 403 AUTHZ_DENIED; mutation=0

requirements.title: Forbid ưu tiên
requirements.text: If an applicable prohibition matches a request, the system shall deny it despite matching permits.

acs.title: Forbid ưu tiên
acs.given: policy permit publish và forbid frozen-tenant
acs.then: 403 AUTHZ_DENIED; provider calls=0

requirements.title: Policy evaluation lỗi
requirements.text: If authorization evaluation reports an error, the system shall deny the protected action.

acs.title: Policy evaluation lỗi
acs.given: permit khớp; forbid thiếu attribute gây diagnostics
acs.then: AUTHZ_EVALUATION_ERROR; không chạy effect; audit ghi diagnostic code không chứa secrets

requirements.title: Không lộ tenant khác
requirements.text: If a requested resource belongs to another tenant, the system shall return the same public response as for a nonexistent resource.

acs.title: Không lộ tenant khác
acs.given: user tenant A; ID thật của B và ID không tồn tại
acs.then: cùng 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND shape; không lộ tên, existence, signed URL hay result count

requirements.title: Quyền hiện hành cho write
requirements.text: When an external write is authorized, the system shall evaluate current membership and policy immediately before dispatch.

acs.title: Quyền hiện hành cho write
acs.given: approval còn hạn nhưng publisher bị revoke trước dispatch
acs.then: 403 AUTHZ_DENIED; mutation transmit=0

requirements.title: Không tin scope từ client
requirements.text: If supplied tenant context conflicts with authenticated resource scope, the system shall reject the request.

acs.title: Không tin scope từ client
acs.given: body tenant_id=B nhưng route/session thuộc A
acs.then: TENANT_CONTEXT_MISMATCH; không chọn B theo body

requirements.title: Step-up cho tác vụ nhạy cảm
requirements.text: When a protected administrative action is requested, the system shall require current server-verified step-up proof.

acs.title: Step-up cho tác vụ nhạy cảm
acs.given: owner có session thường; action secret.rotate
acs.then: STEP_UP_REQUIRED; sau verified MFA dưới L-STEPUP thì được đánh giá quyền tiếp

requirements.title: Machine audience
requirements.text: If a machine token has an incorrect audience, the system shall reject worker access.

acs.title: Machine audience
acs.given: token staging dùng trên API production
acs.then: 401 TOKEN_AUDIENCE_INVALID; command chưa enqueue

requirements.title: Phạm vi delegation
requirements.text: When an agent run invokes a tool, the system shall enforce the intersection of delegation, plugin, principal, resource and policy permissions.

acs.title: Phạm vi delegation
acs.given: run chỉ được draft article A; plugin có publish rộng hơn
acs.then: DELEGATION_DENIED; external calls=0

requirements.title: Automation grant tách session
requirements.text: When an authorized schedule starts, the system shall use its active automation grant rather than a browser session.

acs.title: Automation grant tách session
acs.given: creator đã logout; automation grant còn active
acs.then: run gắn grant ID và tenant; không sử dụng cookie creator

requirements.title: Grant hết hạn
requirements.text: If a delegation expires before an action is dispatched, the system shall block that action.

acs.title: Grant hết hạn
acs.given: clock=expires_at; queued action chưa transmit
acs.then: DELEGATION_EXPIRED; transmit=0

requirements.title: Không tăng quyền qua nội dung
requirements.text: If model output requests capabilities beyond its grant, the system shall reject the additional capabilities.

acs.title: Không tăng quyền qua nội dung
acs.given: tool arguments chứa role=owner và tenant_id khác
acs.then: CAPABILITY_ESCALATION_DENIED; granted set không đổi

requirements.title: Không kế thừa mặc định giữa agent
requirements.text: When an agent delegates to another agent, the system shall restrict the child grant to a subset of the parent grant.

acs.title: Không kế thừa mặc định giữa agent
acs.given: parent chỉ read A; child xin read A,B
acs.then: child grant không có B; request vượt scope bị từ chối

requirements.title: Schema ownership
requirements.text: The system shall restrict each plugin data capability to its published data contract.

acs.title: Schema ownership
acs.given: plugin A không có query contract B
acs.when: A đọc record nội bộ B
acs.then: DATA_SCOPE_DENIED; không trả raw SQL handle

requirements.title: Audit cùng transaction
requirements.text: When a protected business mutation commits, the system shall commit its audit event atomically with that mutation.

acs.title: Audit cùng transaction
acs.given: inject audit write failure trong mutation
acs.then: transaction rollback; không tồn tại business update thiếu audit

requirements.title: Optimistic concurrency
requirements.text: If a command references a stale resource version, the system shall reject it before changing the resource.

acs.title: Optimistic concurrency — case 1
acs.given: resource version 2; request If-Match=1
acs.then: 409 STALE_VERSION; resource giữ v2

acs.title: Optimistic concurrency — case 2
acs.given: hai writer cùng base version=2
acs.then: một update thành công v3; bên thua 409; không merge ngầm

requirements.title: RLS tenant
requirements.text: The data access layer shall enforce tenant isolation under its nonprivileged runtime identity.

acs.title: RLS tenant
acs.given: RLS fixture A/B; runtime DB role không owner/BYPASSRLS
acs.then: không đọc hoặc ghi record B từ tenant A kể cả connection reuse

requirements.title: Transactional outbox
requirements.text: When a committed mutation requires asynchronous delivery, the system shall persist a recoverable delivery intent in the same transaction.

acs.title: Transactional outbox
acs.given: process bị kill ngay sau commit mutation
acs.then: business event được giao; không mất acknowledged intent

requirements.title: Input validation
requirements.text: If a command violates its published schema, the system shall reject it before persistence.

acs.title: Input validation
acs.given: unknown field, payload quá lớn hoặc số ngoài range
acs.then: 400 hoặc 413 theo error catalog; mutation=0

requirements.title: Artifact bất biến
requirements.text: When an artifact is finalized, the system shall make its content digest immutable.

acs.title: Artifact bất biến
acs.given: upload bytes B rồi finalize
acs.when: đọc và thử ghi lại cùng artifact ID
acs.then: digest=SHA256(B); overwrite trả IMMUTABLE_ARTIFACT

requirements.title: Signed URL có scope
requirements.text: When an authorized artifact download is requested, the system shall issue a time-limited locator bound to the authorized artifact.

acs.title: Signed URL có scope
acs.given: user được đọc A, không B
acs.then: locator chỉ đọc A; expires theo L-SIGNEDURL; không liệt kê bucket

requirements.title: Chống nội dung upload nguy hiểm
requirements.text: If an uploaded artifact fails malware or content-type validation, the system shall quarantine it before downstream consumption.

acs.title: Chống nội dung upload nguy hiểm
acs.given: polyglot HTML/image hoặc malware fixture
acs.then: QUARANTINED; preview, model retrieval, public link=0

requirements.title: Retraction propagation
requirements.text: When a source is revoked, the system shall invalidate derived artifacts that depend on its revoked rights.

acs.title: Retraction propagation
acs.given: source S được dùng bởi derived D
acs.then: D marked INVALIDATED; retrieval không trả D; active workflows chuyển BLOCKED

requirements.title: Xóa tới dữ liệu dẫn xuất
requirements.text: When an authorized deletion request executes, the system shall remove eligible active copies and record unresolved external copies.

acs.title: Xóa tới dữ liệu dẫn xuất
acs.given: subject data có cache, index, export, external publication
acs.then: active cache/index bị xóa; external references ghi pending action; không báo xóa toàn bộ khi chưa chứng minh

requirements.title: Legal hold
requirements.text: If an eligible record is under an active legal hold, the system shall block destructive deletion of that record.

acs.title: Legal hold
acs.given: retention hết hạn nhưng hold active
acs.then: HELD; dữ liệu không bị xóa; audit thể hiện hold owner

requirements.title: Backup không hồi sinh dữ liệu xóa
requirements.text: When a backup is restored, the system shall apply deletion tombstones before enabling tenant reads.

acs.title: Backup không hồi sinh dữ liệu xóa
acs.given: backup trước yêu cầu xóa S; tombstone sau đó
acs.then: S không đọc được trước readiness; restore report ghi tombstone replay

requirements.title: Mã hóa payload riêng tư
requirements.text: The system shall encrypt secret-class payloads using keys managed separately from application data storage.

acs.title: Mã hóa payload riêng tư
acs.given: provider conversation/token blob có synthetic secret; database backup được tạo
acs.then: không giải mã được secret; key material không có trong app database dump

requirements.title: Bắt đầu run có idempotency
requirements.text: When a valid run request is accepted, the system shall return one stable run identity for its idempotency scope.

acs.title: Bắt đầu run có idempotency — case 1
acs.given: idempotency key K và fingerprint P chưa tồn tại
acs.then: cùng run ID; một root execution

acs.title: Bắt đầu run có idempotency — case 2
acs.given: K đã dùng với fingerprint P1
acs.then: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; không tạo run mới

requirements.title: Phục hồi sau crash
requirements.text: When a worker restarts, the system shall resume acknowledged nonterminal runs from durable state.

acs.title: Phục hồi sau crash

quality.statement: The framework shall satisfy every mandatory criterion in the selected release partition.
quality.metric: Procedure NFR-FUNC: execute every mapped AC for the selected partition; required test collection >0; pass=100%; skip/error/missing evidence=0. Environment TEST-LOCAL plus stated live gates.

quality.statement: Public contracts shall distinguish unknown outcomes from confirmed success or failure.
quality.metric: Run every Error/EffectReceipt/MetricSnapshot vector; 0 UNKNOWN values coerced to success/zero. Procedure CONTRACT-SEMANTICS.

quality.statement: Authorized metadata reads shall meet the baseline latency objective.
quality.metric: ENV-PERF: 100 requests/s for 30 minutes, 100 tenants, 1,000,000 records; backend p95<=300 ms and p99<=1000 ms, excluding external provider/network time.

quality.statement: The scheduler shall dispatch eligible local work within the baseline delay objective.
quality.metric: ENV-PERF: 20 concurrent tenant shares, 10,000 queued jobs, no external rate limit; p95 enqueue-to-dispatch<=5 seconds for admitted work during 30-minute run.

quality.statement: Sandboxed invocations shall remain within configured memory and deadline ceilings.
quality.metric: L-WASM: 128 MiB memory, 5 seconds guest deadline, 30 seconds host-I/O deadline; 100 malicious invocations terminate without host RSS exceeding 2 GiB in ENV-PERF.

quality.statement: Versioned public APIs shall preserve supported client compatibility.
quality.metric: Run current and immediately preceding minor contract conformance fixtures on major1; 0 changed required meanings or missing fields. Breaking major changes reject explicitly.

quality.statement: Provider continuation state shall survive storage and replay without field loss.
quality.metric: Round-trip native envelopes containing reasoning, phase, tool calls, compaction, unknown items; 0 missing fields/order changes after canonical JSON comparison.

quality.statement: The web shell shall support the defined accessibility interaction profile.
quality.metric: UI-MATRIX: keyboard-only, NVDA/Chrome and VoiceOver/Safari; 0 critical/serious axe findings; manual WCAG 2.2 AA checklist complete at 320/390/768/1440 CSS px and 200% text.

quality.statement: Operational errors shall identify outcome certainty and a usable recovery action.
quality.metric: For every public error code, black-box UI/API assertions verify correlation_id, effect_state and recovery_action; 0 errors labeled success.

quality.statement: Acknowledged run intents shall survive worker interruption without loss.
quality.metric: Fault injection at every outbox, lease, checkpoint and dispatch boundary, 100 repetitions per boundary; acknowledged intent loss=0; recovered pending work visible within 60 seconds in TEST-LOCAL.

quality.statement: Recovery shall meet the proposed recovery targets.
quality.metric: DR-RESTORE on 20 GiB fixture: RPO<=15 minutes for business data, RTO<=4 hours; actual external effect states reconciled before writes. Monthly drill evidence required; figures are proposed targets.

quality.statement: Failed dependencies shall not create falsely confirmed side effects.
quality.metric: Inject timeout,429,5xx,malformed body,connection reset for each connector; 0 successful receipts without remote evidence across fault matrix.

quality.statement: Runtime tenant isolation shall hold across all data surfaces.
quality.metric: TENANT-MATRIX: API,search,cache,SSE,artifact,export,worker,logs; 0 unauthorized records or existence disclosures across A/B fixtures and pooled DB connections.

quality.statement: Secrets shall remain absent from unauthorized sinks.
quality.metric: Canary scan 12 sinks including logs, traces, prompt, browser storage, network payloads, crash dumps, exports and backup logical dumps; plaintext secret matches=0 outside designated encrypted/secret-store boundary.

quality.statement: Protected mutations shall fail closed on authorization or provenance errors.
quality.metric: AUTH-MATRIX including Cedar diagnostics, stale membership, revoked grant,wrong audience and step-up expiry; denied-case mutation count=0.

quality.statement: Sensitive data erasure shall follow the configured lifecycle policy.
quality.metric: DELETE-PROFILE: verify active-copy erasure within approved SLA and backup tombstone replay before reads; 0 falsely completed external deletion claims. Production retention policy must be approved separately.

quality.statement: Domain plugins shall remain independent of kernel implementation details.
quality.metric: Architecture tests find 0 marketing identifiers in kernel and 0 imports of private domain tables/SDK internals across declared boundaries.

quality.statement: Critical control modules shall meet the proposed automated-test coverage floor.
quality.metric: CI coverage on policy adapters, states, idempotency, tenancy and budgets: branch>=90%; every enumerated denial/unknown path has explicit assertion. Coverage alone does not waive missing cases.

quality.statement: Released builds shall be reproducible from pinned inputs.
quality.metric: Two clean builds using same source,locks,toolchain,schemas produce equal unsigned content digests; generated contract drift=0. Signed envelope timestamps excluded.

quality.statement: The framework shall install on the supported Linux deployment profiles.
quality.metric: Clean install/migration/smoke on Linux amd64 and arm64 container profiles; 0 manual source edits; local developer setup supported on macOS via containers.

quality.statement: A new domain shall be implementable solely through supported extension surfaces.
quality.metric: External document-approval fixture and deterministic checksum fixture pass without modifying kernel digest; record public API gaps rather than private-import workarounds.

quality.statement: The global mutation stop shall prevent dispatch before the point of no return.
quality.metric: 100 races between queued dispatch and switch activation; after authoritative switch commit, pre-PONR dispatch count=0; already transmitted actions remain reconcilable.
